lines: Adjusted Pro Forma Operating EBITDA margin expanded 30 basis points to 17.6%. • Board of Directors authorized first common dividend post spin. • Company updates full-year 2026 guidance3 and expects Adjusted Pro Forma Operating EBITDA1 to be in the range of $1.1 to $1.125 billion.
The Company expects to record approximately $130 million to $140 million net pre-tax restructuring charges during 2026 for these activities.
